thread:
Marta (Sales): handing off VelaTech — 12mo, 60 seats, private deploy in us-east-2. asks: SAML SSO, Splunk JSON-lines audit, reserved GPU pool for peak hours, and p50 <300ms on 12 short prompts. flagged renewal-sensitivity if perf not met.

Priya (CS): thanks Marta. assigning Omar as CSM. can you confirm current provisioning status and any blockers? i'll create the onboarding runbook and standing sync.

Marta (Sales): contract & billing done. provisioning started this morning. open items: VPC peering, customer certs, KMS rotation policy, Splunk HEC endpoint. customer requested a reserved pool during 09:00-11:00 local for spikes.

Omar (CSM): i'll own the runbook and be primary contact. proposed runway: day0 networking & infra, day3 SSO + keys, week1 pilot prompts + perf tuning, week2 staged go-live. acceptance: SSO live, Splunk receives JSON-lines with request_id & token_count, median latency <320ms for their core prompts under pilot.

OnboardBot: provisioning update — VPC created; private control plane queued. Remaining tasks: VPN+peering, firewall rules, cert provisioning, KMS key policy, Splunk ingestion test. 4/9 complete.

Rae (Eng): saw the demo logs Marta attached — streaming stalls around token ~750. we need request_id(s) from their environment to correlate with kernel/host traces. short-term mitigations: try redwood-medium-quant on pilot, enable prefix/KV cache for their common template, and reserve a small dedicated pool for the peak window. if repro'd i'll open ENG-12121.

Liam (Support): opening CS ticket CS-7010 and marking ENG triage. please paste sanitized prompt(s) and any request_id values. i'll watch for reproducible traces and escalate if >2 repros in 24h.

Marta (Sales): sanitized snippet for demo: `2024-07-08T10:05:12Z request_id=vt-20240708-9 model=redwood-large seq=765 latency=1420ms step=kv_fetch stream_event=stall duration=1700ms` — demo produced ~950 tokens.

Rae (Eng): thanks. can VelaTech run this from their env and paste the response header request_id so we can pull host logs?

```
curl -s -X POST https://private.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <PROVISION_KEY>" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"<their-long-prompt>","stream":true}' -D - | head
```

Omar (CSM): action items (owners):
- Omar (CSM): runbook + schedule training + weekly sync (due 2024-07-12)
- Rae (Eng): triage streaming stalls & recommend config (due 2024-07-10) — ENG-12121 if repro
- Liam (Support): CS-7010 tracking & escalation on >2 repros
- Marta (Sales): provide sanitized prompts, replay request_ids
- OnboardBot/Infra: finish peering, firewall, certs; share VPN details
- Priya (CS): send standing invite and confirm stakeholders

Priya (CS): capturing enablement asks from customer: 1) private-deploy quickstart for infra team, 2) one-pager on quantization tradeoffs (latency vs quality), 3) runbook template for SSO+Splunk field mapping. they want the one-pager before pilot.

Liam (Support): CS-7010 created, priority=high. watchers: @Rae @Omar. will link ENG-12121 here when created.

Rae (Eng): preliminary suggestion: redwood-medium-quant + prefix cache, increase streaming socket timeout to 60s on control plane, validate dedicated pool size. i'll post a short config diff after repro.

Marta (Sales): client also requested audit fields: request_id, user_id, token_count, model, latency. Omar — can you confirm field mapping and retention with infra once we have their Splunk HEC?

Omar (CSM): will validate field mapping. Priya pls get the HEC endpoint & test key. we'll run an ingestion smoke test before pilot.

OnboardBot: VPN+peering complete. firewall PR awaiting netops approval. Splunk test pending customer key.

Priya (CS): scheduling first weekly sync for next Tue and inviting eng lead for first two meetings. marking renewal-risk=monitor until latency acceptance met in staging.

Rae (Eng): aiming to post initial triage update by 2024-07-10 EOD. :eyes:

Liam (Support): once ENG-12121 exists i'll link it here and add to CS-7010.

Omar (CSM): i'll update the onboarding doc and post runbook link here, then close the handoff. reopen if blockers appear before provisioning completes. :thumbsup:
